description.value: The Large Quarry Garden is a sunken ornamental garden carved into a former basalt quarry within Queen Elizabeth Park in Vancouver, featuring tiered flowerbeds and reflecting pools set against the quarry walls. Situated at one of the highest points in Vancouver, the surrounding park offers panoramic views of the city and North Shore mountains. It is a popular stop on cycling routes through the area and is freely accessible to the public.
